description: This source file contains unit tests for the Orleans serialization system, specifically testing converter-based serialization for foreign types using various test classes that verify cloning and serialization via codecs and copiers. It defines multiple test classes for different foreign and wrapped types, including derived types and value types, to ensure robust serialization support in Orleans.

classes.name: ConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for converter-based serialization of a foreign type.

classes.name: ConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for copying of a foreign type using surrogate converters.

classes.name: WrappedConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for converter serialization involving wrapped foreign types.

classes.name: WrappedConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for copying wrapped foreign types.

classes.name: StructConverterCopierTests

classes.description: Unit tests for wrapped value types via converter codecs.

classes.description: Unit tests for copying wrapped value types.
